units.source_text: 千重子委托织的腰带快接近完成，秀男也就越发高兴了。

en.t: The sash that Chieko had commissioned him to weave was nearly finished, and Hideo grew happier and happier.

units.source_text: 这固然是因为自己倾以全力的工作快要完成，

en.t: Of course, this was because the work into which he had poured all his strength was about to be completed,

units.source_text: 但更重要的是，由于在梭子穿梭、织机发出的声响中，包含了千重子的音容笑貌。

en.t: but more importantly, in the shuttle moving back and forth and in the sound of the loom, Chieko's voice, face, and smile were contained.
